newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks gain further in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks gain further in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter securities market in Varazdin and its Osijek outpost for Wednesday, October 9.
* Nine of 13 active issues rose, one fell, two were flat and one traded for the first time.
* 10-stock VIN index up 11.21 percent to 8,770 points.
* Volume higher at 17,828 units, turnover 753,120 German marks.
* Sole loser was confectioner Kras, down 4.76 percent to 200 marks on volume of 130 shares
* Biggest gainer Jadranhoteli Rijeka, up 60 percent to 40 marks with 91 shares sold. Others:
- Textile firm Varteks, up 30 percent to 26 marks. Also the most actively traded on volume of 11,218 shares
- Hotelier Riviera, adding 17.65 percent to 80 marks on volume of 1,524
- Laguna and Elka both up 16.67 percent to 350 and 70 marks respectively with 86 and 575 shares sold
- Hotelier Jadranturist rose 10 percent to 110 marks, after peaking at 115. It sold 152 shares.
- Electronics firm Ericsson Tesla rose 8.70 percent to 50 marks on volume of 1,142
- Investment fund Breza, selling 500 shares, up 6.38 percent to 50 marks
- Hotelier Istraturist up 2.78 percent to 74 marks with 577 shares.
- Arenaturist at 70 marks with 507 shares. A package of 96 paid and 96 unpaid shares went for a total of 3,000 marks.
- Food processor Podravka at 75 marks on volume of 1,104 units. Its 224 unpaid-for shares changed hands for 3,687 marks.
* In a first deal on OTC market shipper Atlantska Plovidba fetched 70 marks on volume of 126 shares.
